en.hubeali: Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws, said, ‘I heard himasws saying: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘You should be raising your voices with the Salawāt upon mesaww, for it would remove the hypocrisy’.
en.sarwar: 13. Ibn abu ‘Umayr has narrated from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following: “I heard abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) saying, ‘
The Messenger of Allah has said, “Raise your voices with al-Salat (asking from Allah favors for me); it removes hypocrisy.’”
